website.function: Explain SENZ, describe services and these eight products accurately, and take inquiries. It does not sign people in, take payment for an app plan, grant a license, or run a product.

app.function: Run these eight products only after SENZ staff verify payment or a signed agreement. It is not the public website, and creating an account does not grant access.

rules: The app catalog is the only description of what a product does. The website repeats it and does not invent features.
Do not link the website to the app while app.released is false.
Do not describe a product as ticketing, voting, tabulation, a clone studio, staff photo retouching, or a public music chart.
FotoLab stays in the product list and is parked. It is not offered on a plan.
Service prices on the website are for SENZ engagements. App plan prices stay unset until the owner enters them. There is no checkout.

products.name: SENZ AI Workspace
products.function: Draft, summarize, rewrite, and structure real work with saved, versioned outputs.
products.doesNot: It does not browse the web, send, or publish. Every draft needs a person to review it.

products.name: SENZ Communications Intelligence
products.function: Message briefs, stakeholder plans, clarity reviews, and issue preparation with human approval.
products.doesNot: It does not publish or send messages, and it does not replace legal advice or a crisis team.

products.name: SENZ Digital Assistant
products.function: An assistant that answers only from your approved knowledge and hands off to a person.
products.doesNot: It does not take payments or bookings. If an answer is not in the approved knowledge, it goes to a person.

products.name: SENZ FotoLab
products.function: Private photo projects with real non-destructive adjustments, versions, and export.
products.doesNot: It is a private editor, not a retouching service by SENZ staff, and it does not generate images.

products.name: SENZ Client Portal
products.function: Contracted project workspace for milestones, deliverables, revisions, and approvals.
products.doesNot: It is how SENZ delivers a contracted project. It is not a CRM for a customer's own clients.

products.name: SENZ Event Systems
products.function: Event publishing, capacity-safe RSVP, waitlists, check-in, and attendee export.
products.doesNot: It does not sell tickets, and it does not run voting or tabulation.

products.name: SENZ Digital Representative
products.function: Consent-based, disclosed text representative for a brand or person, with human approval.
products.doesNot: Text only, and only while recorded consent is current. It is not a voice or video likeness and is never the real person.

products.name: SENZ Music Platform
products.function: Protected audio previews, timestamped feedback, rights confirmation, and delivery.
products.doesNot: It does not stream music to the public or publish charts. The public SENZ Music page is a division showcase, not this product.
